raw_text: The Atlantic Council's Digital Forensic Research Lab has independently verified key findings from the EU DisinfoLab Indian Chronicles report. Our analysis confirms the existence of a coordinated network of at least 750 inauthentic media outlets linked to a New Delhi-based entity. We identified three distinct operational layers: (1) a content production hub generating 100+ articles daily, (2) a distribution network of satellite websites across 116 countries that republished this content, and (3) a lobbying arm consisting of shell NGOs with UN accreditation. Network analysis reveals the operation persisted and expanded even after the initial 2019 EU DisinfoLab exposure. The Indian Chronicles case represents one of the longest-running and most geographically distributed influence operations documented to date.
